title: Niagara Falls Day Tour from Toronto (9 Hours)
includes: Round-trip coach transportation from an easily accessible, central location in Toronto
If selected: Boat cruise runs April–November. Journey Behind the Falls is offered in winter months
Main attraction ticket IF selected: Boat cruise (in season) OR Journey Behind the Falls (in winter)
Boat tour (summer) or Journey Behind the Falls (winter) unless selected (not included)
Niagara on the Lake and Whirlpool are seasonal stops (not included)
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
policies: Itinerary is subject to change without notice
This tour operates in all weather conditions
Niagara on the Lake and Whirlpool is a seasonal stop
The boat cruise is usually available from May to October, but exact dates are weather dependent and out of our control.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Leave behind the Toronto bustle to experience the remarkable natural beauty of Niagara Falls. Relax in your reclining seat and enjoy the WiFi on the late model climate controlled coach. On this full-day tour, we arrive early at Niagara Falls to maximize on your experience and avoid the larger crowds. Take your skip the ticket line and hop on a Niagara Cruise boat with your keepsake poncho or the Journey Behind the Falls excursion, depending on the season (if option selected). Cruise up Niagara River for up-close views of the awesome Horseshoe Falls. Join your English-speaking guide for lunch (if option selected) - taking in views above the falls. Board the late-model coach again and head to the Whirlpool Rapids observation deck. In the summer months enjoy a stop at Niagara-on-the-lake and a Maple Syrup tasting experience.
